tagline: Keep your team informed of calendar events in Slack and reduce meeting no-shows automatically
metaTitle: Slack Google Calendar Status: Sync Meetings to Your Status
metaDescription: Set your Slack status from Google Calendar meetings and post daily schedules to team channels. GAIA also books meetings from Slack. See the setup steps.
intro:
Calendar events and Slack conversations are deeply connected in practice but completely disconnected in software. A meeting gets added to Google Calendar, but nobody in the workspace knows about it unless someone manually announces it. A discussion concludes with a decision to schedule a meeting, but that requires leaving the chat and opening the calendar. Status information about who's in a meeting versus available sits in the calendar but doesn't appear in Slack.

GAIA connects the two so they reinforce each other. Upcoming meetings can be announced in the right channels automatically. Statuses can reflect your current calendar state—in a meeting, heads-down block, or out of office—without manual updates. Meetings can be scheduled from a conversation by simply asking GAIA to find a time that works.

For distributed teams where chat is the operational heartbeat, having calendar context surfaced automatically means fewer missed meetings, better coordination around availability, and a status that's actually accurate.

useCases.title: Post daily meeting schedules to team channels
useCases.description: Each morning, GAIA posts a summary of the day's scheduled meetings to the relevant channels, so the team knows what's on the agenda and can coordinate around focus time and meeting blocks.

useCases.title: Automatic Slack status from Google Calendar
useCases.description: GAIA reads your calendar and automatically updates your status when you're in a meeting ('In a meeting until 3pm'), on a focus block ('Do not disturb'), or out of office ('OOO until Monday').

useCases.title: Schedule Google Calendar meetings from Slack
useCases.description: When a thread concludes with a decision to meet, ask GAIA to find a time that works for all participants, create the event, and post the event link back to the thread.

useCases.title: Pre-meeting reminders by DM
useCases.description: GAIA sends a DM reminder 10 minutes before scheduled meetings with the event title, attendees, video link, and any relevant prep notes from the event description.

useCases.title: Alert channels when key team members are unavailable
useCases.description: When a team lead or key contributor has an all-day event or extended meeting block, GAIA notifies the relevant channel so the team knows in advance and can plan accordingly.

howItWorks.description: Authenticate your Slack workspace and Google Calendar account in GAIA's settings. GAIA accesses calendar events and can post to channels and DMs you authorize.
Tell GAIA which calendars to monitor, which channels should receive which types of notifications, and how far in advance reminders should be sent. Define status update rules in plain language.

howItWorks.step: Both tools stay in sync automatically
howItWorks.description: GAIA monitors your calendar and updates the workspace proactively. Meeting reminders, status updates, and scheduling requests all happen automatically without you having to bridge the two tools manually.

faqs.question: Can GAIA update Slack statuses for all team members or just the connected user?
faqs.answer: GAIA updates status for each user who connects their own calendar. For team-wide status updates, each team member authenticates their own calendar and chat accounts, and GAIA manages their statuses individually.

faqs.question: Which Google Calendar events trigger notifications?
faqs.answer: You configure the triggers. Common setups include all events on a team calendar, events matching specific keywords (all-hands, client meeting, launch), or events involving specific attendees. GAIA filters based on your rules.

faqs.question: Can GAIA handle calendar invites requested in a message?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can ask GAIA in a message to schedule a meeting with specific people, and GAIA will check calendar availability, create the event, send invites through the calendar, and post the event summary back to the conversation.

faqs.question: Does GAIA work with shared and resource calendars?
faqs.answer: GAIA can monitor shared team calendars and resource calendars (like meeting rooms) in addition to personal calendars. This is useful for posting conference room availability or shared team schedule updates to channels.
